text: Over an arbitrary field, every operator is similar to a block-diagonal matrix of companion matrices C(f₁),…,C(f_r) with f₁ | f₂ | ⋯ | f_r; this is the ___ canonical form.
explanation: The rational canonical form (Frobenius normal form) classifies operators up to similarity without needing eigenvalues, so it works over any field — unlike Jordan form, which needs the characteristic polynomial to split. The last invariant factor f_r is the minimal polynomial.
